This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

WWII tanks covered in spikes were how US crews in the Pacific stopped Japanese infantry from climbing onto Shermans with satchel charges. Hardware-store construction spikes, welded point-up—no lab test, pure survival. What other tank mods should we cover?
